0cESbNbpYyJtuodHwEBVqA.zh: 德國今年6月迄今報告39例病例,且上一個流行季(2025年6月迄今年3月)累計報告116例病例,其中至少24例住院,全基因組定序顯示,本次流行菌株與歐洲(17個國家)於2011-24年期間疫情(逾600 例)流行之菌株,以及奧地利於2025年檢出之菌株相,疑感染源為義大利進口之番茄,懷疑為灌溉用水受汙染所致。當局警告疫情屬跨年性⻑期流行,且受污染番茄已流入多個歐洲國家。
0cESbNbpYyJtuodHwEBVqA.en: Germany has reported 39 cases since June this year. The previous epidemic season (June 2025 to March this year) reported 116 cases in total, at least 24 of whom were hospitalised. Whole-genome sequencing shows that the outbreak strain is closely related to strains that circulated in Europe (17 countries) during 2011–24 (over 600 cases), as well as to a strain detected in Austria in 2025. The suspected source is tomatoes imported from Italy, with contaminated irrigation water suspected as the cause. Authorities warn that this is a multi-year outbreak and that contaminated tomatoes have reached several European countries.

d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

iw1z7K0j7F6qPHRAhx-a2A.en: As of 3 September this year, 15 European countries have cumulatively reported 1,086 locally acquired cases, including 61 deaths (CFR 6%). The case count exceeds the average of 736 for the same period over the past 10 years. Cases are concentrated in Italy (516), Greece (284) and Spain (88), among others; the Netherlands reported its first human case since 2020. Bird and equine cluster outbreaks continue to be reported. Although there is no sign that disease severity is increasing, authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in the coming weeks.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

ZiNMNeFBb-mdO5yNtRxdyA.zh: 歐洲報告1例義大利西西里島巴勒摩(Palermo)4歲兒童死亡案例,該童未接種疫苗,於8/10-11出現發燒、食慾不振、嘔吐等症狀,8/15出現高燒及呼吸困難,住院接受治療,8/20死亡。該國衛生研究院(Istituto Superiore di Sanità,ISS)於8/25檢驗出白喉棒狀桿菌,其後報告第2例疑病例,為指標病例之4歲表親,症狀較輕,已住院治療。ECDC評估歐盟地區整體疫苗覆蓋率高,傳播機率風險低,然而疫苗接種率低之弱勢族群仍可能出現散發病例,ECDC將持續監測此事件及追蹤接觸者。
ZiNMNeFBb-mdO5yNtRxdyA.en: A death has been reported in Europe of a 4-year-old unvaccinated child in Palermo, Sicily, Italy. The child developed fever, poor appetite and vomiting on 10–11 August, high fever and breathing difficulties on 15 August, was hospitalised for treatment, and died on 20 August. On 25 August, Italy's National Institute of Health (Istituto Superiore di Sanità, ISS) detected Corynebacterium diphtheriae. A second suspected case was subsequently reported, a 4-year-old cousin of the index case with milder symptoms, who has been hospitalised for treatment. ECDC assesses that overall vaccination coverage in the EU is high and the risk of transmission is low; however, sporadic cases may still occur among vulnerable groups with low vaccination rates, and ECDC will continue to monitor the event and trace contacts.

LJ2220cWWpJUxGTtFu4TAQ.en: As of 5 August this year, seven European countries had cumulatively reported 245 cases, of which 12 died (CFR 5%). Cases are concentrated in Italy (139), Greece (65) and Spain (17), among others. Patients are mostly men aged over 65, and 72% required hospitalisation. The current outbreak is below the same-period average of the past 10 years (403 cases), but geographic spread is wider, and several countries have reported locally acquired cases for the first time in new areas. The transmission season for this disease is May to November each year. Authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and human and animal cases are expected to continue rising in August and September.

-Gwobo5uk-C3ibqoVUpQjA.en: Greece has reported 65 cases cumulatively this year as of 5 August, of which 6 were fatal (all aged over 65). Cases are distributed across 25 administrative areas, and most patients presented with central nervous system (CNS) symptoms. The epidemic in the country usually circulates between May and November. Italy has reported 84 cases cumulatively from February to 28 July this year, of which 2 were fatal; 19 were asymptomatic infections detected through blood donation. The overall outbreak is comparable to the same period last year.

_1us1I8gl2vFEScXV_045Q.en: Omsk Oblast in the Russian Federation has reported three confirmed human rabies deaths since early April 2026. All patients were bitten by household cats or dogs and did not seek, or refused, timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and died as a result. The country records two to six rabies deaths each year, and Omsk Oblast had reached or exceeded the national annual lower limit for deaths by late May this year. In Italy's Veneto Region, one dog illegally imported from Morocco was confirmed infected with rabies on 27 May and was euthanised. No human infections have been reported. This is the first animal case reported in the country in nearly 15 years. Experts stress the need for a cross-sectoral One Health response, with strict compliance with animal quarantine and vaccination rules for cross-border movement, to prevent a recurrence of zoonotic outbreaks.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. aOA2Oynbv2QRyVzHFGvbrA.zh: 義大利於3/21通報1例H9N2人類流感病例,病患為成年個案,曾至塞內加爾6個月,三月中旬前往達義大利,病患因出現發燒及咳嗽等症狀至急診就醫,16 日經檢驗結核分枝桿菌呈陽性,及無法分型之 A 型流感病毒,收治於負壓隔離病房,並接受抗結核藥物及克流感(Oseltamivir)抗病毒治療,目前病況穩定,20 日確診為H9亞型,21日經定序(NGS)確診為A(H9N2),基因證據顯示該病毒源自塞內加爾相關禽類譜系,義大利刻正進行病毒細胞培養分離。病患無直接接觸動物/野生動物或出入農村地區活動史,亦無接觸過確診或疑症狀患者,塞內加爾境內接觸者皆無症狀,義大利境內已取得聯繫之接觸者採檢皆為流感陰性。WHO評估多數A(H9N2) 病例與暴露於受感染禽類或受污染環境有關,臨床症狀多為輕症。由於該病毒在禽類中呈地方性流行,預期仍會出現散發人類病例。
aOA2Oynbv2QRyVzHFGvbrA.en: On 21 March, Italy reported one human H9N2 influenza case. The patient is an adult who spent six months in Senegal and travelled to Italy in mid-March. The patient went to the emergency department with fever and cough. On 16 March, tests were positive for Mycobacterium tuberculosis and for an influenza A virus that could not be subtyped. The patient was admitted to a negative-pressure isolation ward and treated with anti-tuberculosis drugs and the antiviral oseltamivir. The patient's condition is currently stable. H9 subtype was confirmed on 20 March, and A(H9N2) was confirmed by next-generation sequencing (NGS) on 21 March. Genetic evidence indicates the virus derives from a lineage associated with poultry in Senegal, and Italy is currently carrying out virus isolation in cell culture. The patient had no direct contact with animals or wildlife and no history of visits to rural areas, and had no contact with confirmed or suspected cases. Asymptomatic contacts in Senegal, and the contacts in Italy who were sampled, all tested negative for influenza. The WHO assesses that most A(H9N2) cases are associated with exposure to infected poultry or contaminated environments, and that clinical symptoms are mostly mild. Because the virus is endemic in poultry, sporadic human cases are expected to continue.

869rOrYuJ18Itbuo6gAY1A.zh: 人類疫情:義大利新增1例H9N2流感人類感染病例,中國新增2例H9N2及1例H1N1v流感人類感染病例。今年累計報告H5N1流感3例、H9N2流感8例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計51國家/地區報告2,285起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  共18國於2026/3/20-2026/3/27期間報告89起H5N1疫情,波蘭17起、泊爾/瑞典各12起、荷蘭9起、英國7起、愛沙亞/比利時各6起、南韓4起、法國3起、挪威/捷克/摩爾多瓦/芬蘭各2起、奧地利/德國/愛爾蘭/斯洛維亞/義大利各1起。 共2國於2026/3/21-26期間報告4起H5 (N untyped)疫情,秘魯3起、比利時1起。 丹麥於2026/3/20報告1起H5N5疫情。 南韓於2026/3/23報告4起H5N9疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/15-21共445個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/加州共9個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
869rOrYuJ18Itbuo6gAY1A.en: Human cases: Italy reported 1 new human H9N2 influenza infection, and China reported 2 new H9N2 cases and 1 new H1N1v human infection. So far this year, 3 cases of H5N1, 8 cases of H9N2 and 1 case of H10N3 have been reported cumulatively; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 51 countries and regions have reported 2,285 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. A total of 18 countries reported 89 H5N1 outbreaks during 20–27 March 2026: Poland 17, Nepal and Sweden 12 each, the Netherlands 9, the United Kingdom 7, Estonia and Belgium 6 each, South Korea 4, France 3, Norway, Czechia, Moldova and Finland 2 each, and Austria, Germany, Ireland, Slovenia and Italy 1 each. Two countries reported 4 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 21–26 March 2026: Peru 3 and Belgium 1. Denmark reported 1 H5N5 outbreak on 20 March 2026. South Korea reported 4 H5N9 outbreaks on 23 March 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided test results from 445 sampling sites for 15–21 March 2026, of which 9 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois and California detected H5-positive results.

SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

Jjig7Njc3Di0uQcwjnaj0g.zh: 中國今年截至2月累計報告2,106例,雖低於2025年同期(4,515例),惟仍高於2024年同期(1,859)例。 印度克拉拉州埃爾訥古勒姆(Ernakulam)區今年1、2月各報告逾150例病例,疫情為該州歷年最高。 義大利那不勒斯(Naples)3/22新增7例病例,疑因生食餐廳海鮮導致感染,當局表示可能與情人節等假期用餐有關。
Jjig7Njc3Di0uQcwjnaj0g.en: China reported 2,106 cases cumulatively this year through February, lower than the 4,515 cases in the same period of 2025, but still higher than the 1,859 cases in the same period of 2024. In Ernakulam District of Kerala State, India, more than 150 cases were reported in each of January and February this year, the highest for the state in its history. In Naples, Italy, 7 new cases were reported on 22 March. The infection is suspected to have been caused by eating raw seafood at restaurants, and authorities said it may be related to holiday meals such as Valentine's Day.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年累計報告458,840例病例及146例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加,10月報告病例數較9月增加108%,近2個月病例主要分布於美洲及亞洲。  今年美洲累計266,165例病例及118例死亡,較去年同期為低,以南美洲巴西病例數最多,其中,該國中西部和東南部地區在過去3週疫情最為嚴峻,並預期11月病例數將再度上升。 今年亞洲累計136,233例病例,較去年同期為低,以東南亞印度病例數最多;中國廣東省自7月疫情爆發以來,近期每週病例數呈下降趨勢,惟10月病例數較9月增加,香港及廣西壯族自治區亦有報告病例。 今年歐洲共2國報告病例,法國累計804例本土病例;義大利累計385例本土病例。
ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.en: Global update: This year, 458,840 cases and 146 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with case numbers higher than the same period last year. Reported cases in October rose 108% from September, and in the past two months cases have been mainly distributed in the Americas and Asia. The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. Cases have also been reported in Hong Kong and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Two European countries have reported cases this year: France has 804 cumulative locally acquired cases and Italy has 385.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

8nZGL93VW54IWsMkbiFROw.zh: 義大利北部艾米利亞羅馬涅區(Emilia Romagna)10/29報告逾50例病例(含疑),其中19例確診、3例住院,感染源調查中。另該國自2023年迄今累積報告逾100例病例,主要感染源為產自西西里之番茄。
8nZGL93VW54IWsMkbiFROw.en: In Emilia-Romagna in northern Italy, more than 50 cases (including suspected cases) had been reported as of 29 October, of which 19 were confirmed and 3 were hospitalized; the source of infection is under investigation. The country has also reported more than 100 cases cumulatively since 2023, and the main source of infection is tomatoes produced in Sicily.

is0XbmAc3TKm2ZQm8UHZpQ.zh: 歐洲疾病預防與控制中心(ECDC)公布今年迄今累計14國,通報逾1,000例本土病例,其中,63例死亡,以義大利(714例)最多,其次為希臘。另德國於2019-24年間每年約4-35例本地病例,大部分來自該國東部地區,惟近期於南部巴伐利亞邦亦報告自2019年以來首例病例,當局提醒至當地參加啤酒節活動之旅客應注意防範蚊蟲叮咬措施。 美國洛杉磯郡報告今年首例死亡病例,個案為聖費爾南多谷地區之居民,因感染後引起神經系統疾病住院並死亡,該郡迄今共通報14例病例,50%感染者居住在聖費爾南多谷地區,當地蚊媒高峰期自6月持續到11月。
is0XbmAc3TKm2ZQm8UHZpQ.en: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports that so far this year, 14 countries have reported more than 1,000 locally acquired cases, of which 63 died, with Italy (714 cases) the most affected, followed by Greece. Germany reported about 4–35 locally acquired cases per year in 2019–24, mostly from the east of the country. Recently, however, it has also reported its first case since 2019 in the southern state of Bavaria, and authorities remind travellers attending beer festival events in the area to take precautions against mosquito bites. United States: Los Angeles County reported its first death of the year, a resident of the San Fernando Valley who was hospitalized and died after developing a neurological disease following infection. The county has reported 14 cases so far, and 50% of those infected live in the San Fernando Valley. The local mosquito peak season runs from June through November.

ALaYwArQpeV1ZduMXTiWEA.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(10/5-11)新增2,257例病例,以江門市新增1,255例最多,其次為廣州市及佛山市分別新增201及196例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市持續落實突發公共衛生事件三級響應措施,該市疫情呈波動下降趨勢,惟仍處較高點。由於廣東省仍處病媒蚊活躍期且假期人潮流動等因素,疫情傳播風險持續。 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至10/8共2國報告病例,法國近1週新增63例本土病例,累計700例;義大利累計353例本土病例。
ALaYwArQpeV1ZduMXTiWEA.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (5–11 October), 2,257 new cases were reported. Jiangmen City had the most, with 1,255 new cases, followed by Guangzhou (201) and Foshan (196). No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen City continues to implement Level III public health emergency response measures; its outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend but remains at a relatively high level. Because Guangdong remains in the active season for disease-carrying mosquitoes and holiday travel continues, the risk of transmission persists. Europe: As of 8 October this year, two countries had reported cases. France recorded 63 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total to 700, and Italy has 353 cumulative locally acquired cases.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.zh: 義大利疫情更新,今年迄今累計582例病例及39例死亡(CFR:15%),其中有260例病例發生侵犯神經系統症狀,病例主要分布於拉吉歐及坎帕亞大區。歐洲今年截至9/3,包括義大利、希臘、塞爾維亞、法國、羅馬亞、匈牙利、西班牙、阿爾巴亞及保加利亞等國均有報告本土病例。
_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.en: Italy's outbreak update: so far this year, 582 cases and 39 deaths have been reported (CFR: 15%), of which 260 cases had neuroinvasive symptoms; cases are mainly in the Lazio and Campania regions. As of 3 September this year, locally acquired cases have been reported in Europe in several countries, including Italy, Greece, Serbia, France, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Albania and Bulgaria.

6G9eUu9ssXglNnsiI-XBJw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/31-9/6)新增178例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市85例最多,其次為廣州市40例,病例數呈下降趨勢,由於移入風險持續、部分地區病媒蚊活躍及氣候等因素,當地仍持續進行病媒蚊防治等工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增74例本土病例,今年累計301例本土病例,義大利今年累計107例本土病例。
6G9eUu9ssXglNnsiI-XBJw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (31 August–6 September), 178 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 85 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 40. Case numbers show a downward trend; because the risk of importation continues, vector mosquitoes remain active in some areas, and climatic factors, vector control work continues locally. Europe outbreak update: France reported 74 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total this year to 301 locally acquired cases. Italy has cumulatively reported 107 locally acquired cases this year.

QunLQo5aYaYos3HjUM__RA.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,自7/8報告首例移入病例以來,累計近1萬例病例,近1週(8/17-23)新增336例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市206例最多,其次為廣州市62例,相較於前1週(8/10-16)新增830例,病例數持續呈現下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增45例本土病例,今年累計156例本土病例;義大利近1週新增22例本土病例,今年累計29例本土病例。
QunLQo5aYaYos3HjUM__RA.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease. Since the first imported case was reported on 8 July, nearly 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported. In the past week (17–23 August), 336 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 206 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 62. Compared with 830 new cases in the previous week (10–16 August), case numbers continue to show a downward trend, and authorities continue outbreak prevention and control. Europe outbreak update: France reported 45 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 156 cumulative locally acquired cases this year; Italy reported 22 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 29 cumulative locally acquired cases this year.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.zh: 義大利疫情上升,今年迄今累計173例病例及11例死亡,其中72例病例出現神經症狀。歐洲今年截至8/6,包括保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、匈牙利、羅馬亞等6國均曾報告確診病例。
XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.en: Italy's outbreak is rising: so far this year, 173 cases and 11 deaths have been cumulatively reported, of which 72 cases had neurological symptoms. As of 6 August this year, six European countries, including Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy, Hungary and Romania, had reported confirmed cases.

5lbhT3VnidlBJ6It_s3HTQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至7/30,歐洲之保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、羅馬亞等5國均曾報告確診病例,其中以義大利中部拉蒂納省43例為多,希臘亦報告17例本土病例。
5lbhT3VnidlBJ6It_s3HTQ.en: Europe outbreak update: as of 30 July this year, Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy and Romania had reported confirmed cases. Among them, Latina Province in central Italy reported the most, with 43 cases. Greece also reported 17 locally acquired cases.

Dl6BOmP7v2rZzSLarzhT-g.zh: 義大利截至7/29已報告7例死亡,分布於拉吉歐、坎帕亞、皮埃蒙特等地,有別於以往疫情多分布於北部地區,今年疫情亦於該國中、南部地區發生,當局已採取病媒蚊防治及限制捐血等措施,預期於8月達疫情高峰。
Dl6BOmP7v2rZzSLarzhT-g.en: As of 29 July, Italy has reported 7 deaths, in regions including Lazio, Campania and Piedmont. Unlike past seasons, when outbreaks were mainly in the north, this year's cases have also occurred in central and southern parts of the country. Authorities have implemented mosquito vector control and restrictions on blood donation, and a peak is expected in August.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

m4m7ZpJUV8miH5dSfbWp-g.zh: 義大利北部皮亞琴察省報告1例疑本土病例,個案為65歲以上男性,出現發燒、肌肉疼痛、關節疼痛、結膜炎等症狀,近期無流行地區旅遊史,為當地首次報告病例。當局已展開清除病媒蚊等防治措施。
m4m7ZpJUV8miH5dSfbWp-g.en: Piacenza Province in northern Italy has reported one suspected locally acquired case, a man over 65 years old with fever, muscle pain, joint pain and conjunctivitis. He had no recent travel history to epidemic areas. This is the first case reported locally in the area. Authorities have begun vector mosquito control and other prevention measures.

56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. As of 5 June, 34 states have reported 17 outbreaks in the country, with 1,168 cumulative cases, including 137 hospitalized and 3 deaths.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

From 1 January 2023 to 5 November 2024, 16 countries reported 232 cases, with Italy the most affected at 67 cases, followed by Germany at 62. Investigations show that genetic sequencing results indicate the outbreak strains share a common source. Tomatoes produced in the Sicily region of Italy are the possible source, but the actual source and contamination route are still to be clarified.
